title: LineEdit editing_toggled signal is not fired on calling unedit()
body:
### Tested versions

-Repreducable in: v4.4.1-stable
-Not Repreducable in earlier versions because signal didnt exist yet.

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Nobara Linux 41 (KDE Plasma) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 9 6900HX with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

When unedit() is called from script the editing_toggled signal is not fired. This makes the editing_toggled signal functionally identical to the focus_entered/exited signals from the parent control node. 

Not that someone else in the Forums tested this and reproduced the error on unknown hardware.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a LineEdit Node
2. Connect the editing_toggled signal to a debug method
3. Attach the script that unselects it in any way, say for testing by pressing h
4. Run the game and select the lineEdit Node
5. Do whatever you script needs to call unedit, for example press h.
6. Watch the debug method not get called.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Archive.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19554480/Archive.zip)
